field_rules.id: Must match an id in capability-reading-index.json.
field_rules.type: One of skill, plugin, mcp, cli, app, proxy, workflow, prompt.
field_rules.does: Array of concrete things this capability is good at.
field_rules.does_not: Array of boundaries. These are used to prevent wrong routing.
field_rules.requires: Array of inputs or preconditions needed before use.
field_rules.confusable_with: Array of nearby capability ids that often compete with this one.
field_rules.auto_apply_when: Array of high-confidence conditions where use is safe.
field_rules.suggest_only_when: Array of conditions where it should be shown as a candidate but not auto-used.
